As an Expert in the Method Development Team in Process Analytical Sciences (PAS), you will be responsible for physicochemical method development, optimization, and robustness testing in late-phase pharmaceutical drug development. Using state-of-the-art technologies and scientific expertise, you will support Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) process development within a multidisciplinary project team. We are seeking an experienced scientist with strong analytical expertise, proficiency in data and digital tools, and comprehensive knowledge of DS and DP process development.

The role combines experimental laboratory work with technical documentation. The ideal candidate should therefore be comfortable working both in and outside the laboratory.

· Plan, organize, perform, and document physicochemical method development, including HPLC and CE, in compliance with internal quality and HSE standards.
· Use chromatographic, statistical, and other software tools to increase efficiency.
· Support the implementation, handover, and transfer of analytical methods
· Collaborate with PAS laboratories, Analytical Experts, and cross-functional teams to ensure effective analytical workflows.
· Design and execute physicochemical analytical approaches for DS, DP, and process intermediates in accordance with Quality by Design principles.
· Interpret analytical results and apply data and digital solutions to improve efficiency. 
· Author and review scientific reports, support regulatory submissions
· Manage multiple priorities, communicate challenges proactively, and resolve complex issues.
· Promote knowledge sharing, present results internally, and contribute to publications, presentations, and patents.
· Evaluate new analytical technologies, develop innovative methods using DoE principles, and ensure alignment with scientific standards. 

What You Will Bring to the Role

· University degree in pharmaceutical technology, biotechnology, biochemistry, chemistry, chemical engineering, or another relevant natural science discipline.
· At least 2 years of experience with an MSc or 1 year with a PhD in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry.
· Knowledge of Analytical Development.
· Expertise in biologics DS and DP process development using QbD principles.
· Excellent collaboration skills, including communication, teamwork, and problem-solving.
· Proficiency in written and spoken English; German is beneficial.
· Strong proficiency in digital technologies.

Rewards

In addition to a market-competitive base salary, we offer an attractive incentive program, a modern company pension scheme, childcare facilities, learning and development opportunities, and worldwide career opportunities within the Novartis group.

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment with diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

If you require an adjustment during the recruitment process because of a medical condition, physical disability, or neurodiverse condition, contact disabilities.austria@novartis.com with details of your request and your contact information.

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We br... 1 Software Engineer - Engine Integration (m/f/d) Job description
Our Product Engineers are domain experts first, developers second. They build Engines - the simulations and models that capture how buildings actually behave - fast, and increasingly with AI. But these prototypes live on GitHub and only run on laptops: untested against the platform, unavailable to customers.

That's the gap you close. You're the key counterpart to our Product Engineers: you understand what an Engine computes, how, and why - well enough to decide where each piece belongs, hand off what belongs to other teams, and build the rest yourself. No finished spec lands in your inbox. You read other people's code, ask the right questions, and turn a working prototype into a service we can run and trust. We work in a strongly agentic way - so will you.

Your mission
 * Run our Engines and make them better - correct, fast, observable. When results look wrong, you can tell whether it's the data, the integration, or the physics.

 * Onboard new prototypes - understand the method and edge cases; judge what's production-ready and what needs a rewrite.

 * Find the right home for each function - decompose monoliths and define the interfaces and data contracts that make those boundaries real.

 * Integrate - with Planning and our Systems Architects, translating between domain and platform language, then build what remains yourself.

 * Make the next Engine easier than the last - shape the conventions that let prototypes arrive closer to integration-ready.

You won't do this alone: DevOps, App/Experience, AI, and Data & Flows already own their domains.

Your profile
 * Several years of professional software engineering across the stack, centre of gravity in the backend.

 * Python and TypeScript - strong in one, comfortable in the other, attached to neither.

 * The ability to read and judge code you didn't write, including scientific and numerical code.

 * A low-ego, collaborative style with domain experts, and the skill to explain trade-offs to people who think in physics, not architecture.

 * Professional English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

Nice-to-have

 * Geometry in code (computational geometry, meshes, CAD or BIM/IFC).

 * Simulation and numerical methods (thermal/energy simulation, FEM/CFD, solvers).

 * Real experience with AI and agentic workflows.

 * Productionizing research or prototype code (ML pipelines, scientific computing, quant models).

 * Building-industry or energy-domain exposure.

Why us?
 * Real impact. The Engines you integrate don't sit in a demo - they feed real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - you work across a complete product portfolio, not isolated one-off projects. Every Engine you bring in has a real place in the whole.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option and a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000 - €75,000 gross/year, depending on your experience.

About us
OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it!

Ready to leave your mark on a market? 

The France and Benelux market is still wide open - we're looking for someone who wants a say in how it's built, not just someone to execute someone else's playbook. If you want real ownership and a direct line to the people making decisions, keep reading.

You'll own the France & Benelux partner ecosystem from day one, while also managing leads and accounts for selected opportunities in DACH - with room to expand into additional markets as the business grows.

What you'll do

 * Grow and develop the partner network - distributors, resellers, system integrators - across France and Benelux: recruit new partners, and take the existing ones to the next level through account management and joint go-to-market planning.

 * Create your own pipeline - develop relationships with partners and end customers directly, routing opportunities through the right partners.

 * Manage leads and accounts for selected opportunities in DACH - working alongside our existing DACH team, with growing ownership as you gain experience.

What's in it for you

 * Real ownership of a market that's still mostly untapped - a few partners exist, but the network is yours to build and develop.

 * Direct access and visibility, including regular contact with our CEO.

 * A path to more markets, more influence, and more responsibility as you grow - where you take this in two years is largely up to you.

 * Benefits like extra days off, Wiener Linien Ticket and regular team events.

 * Annual salary: EUR 60,000-83,000 gross OTE.

What you bring

 * Several years of experience in sales, channel development, business development, or account management.

 * A proactive, hunter mindset - you create opportunities, you don't wait for them.

 * Strong communication skills; comfortable picking up the phone and engaging stakeholders at every level, from technical teams to senior leadership and C-suite, and building relationships with distributors, integrators, and end customers.

 * Self-organized and independent - you set your own priorities and drive your own schedule.

 * German: minimum C1 · French: minimum C1 · English: professional working proficiency.

Nice to have: experience in IT, networking, infrastructure, or data centers; familiarity with distributors/VARs/system integrators; CRM experience (HubSpot a plus).
